projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.shortDescription: A full-featured e-commerce platform with real-time inventory management and payment processing. Handles thousands of products with sub-second page loads.
projects.fullDescription: Built a comprehensive e-commerce solution from scratch, handling thousands of products and processing secure payments. Implemented real-time inventory tracking, user authentication, and an admin dashboard with analytics. The platform serves over 5,000 active users monthly with 99.9% uptime.
features: Real-time inventory management with WebSocket updates
projects.challenges: Optimising database queries for large product catalogs while maintaining sub-second page loads required implementing Redis caching and database indexing strategies.

projects.title: Task Management App
projects.shortDescription: A collaborative task management application with real-time updates, drag-and-drop boards, and team workspaces. Inspired by Trello and Jira.
projects.fullDescription: Developed a full-stack task management application supporting team collaboration. Features include Kanban boards with drag-and-drop, real-time synchronisation across clients, role-based access control, and integration with Slack for notifications.
projects.challenges: Implementing conflict resolution for simultaneous edits by multiple users required a careful operational transformation approach on the server side.

projects.title: Weather Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: An interactive weather dashboard that displays current conditions, 7-day forecasts, and historical weather data with beautiful data visualisations.
projects.fullDescription: Built a weather dashboard consuming multiple public APIs to provide accurate forecasts, hourly breakdowns, and historical trends. Features interactive charts, city search with autocomplete, and location-based weather detection.
features: Real-time weather data from OpenWeather API
Interactive charts for temperature and precipitation
projects.challenges: Handling rate limits from multiple weather APIs gracefully while keeping data fresh required an intelligent caching and fallback strategy.

projects.title: Developer Portfolio Generator
projects.shortDescription: A CLI tool that generates customisable developer portfolio websites from a simple JSON configuration file. Supports multiple themes and deployment targets.
projects.fullDescription: Created an open-source CLI tool that allows developers to generate professional portfolio websites without writing code. Users provide a JSON config file and the tool generates a full Next.js application with their chosen theme.
features: SEO optimisation out of the box
projects.challenges: Designing a flexible but opinionated template system that works for a wide variety of portfolio content without requiring users to touch code.
